bias.en: Pullback · SAR flipped bearish, MACD below zero
bias.zh: 回调 · SAR 转为看空，MACD 跌至零轴下方

read.en: Microsoft fell 2.3% on Nov 17 to $506.24, trading $496.51–515.64. It is below the 5-day ($518.5), 10-day ($529.3) and 30-day ($529.5), all falling, and above the 100-day ($483.1) and 200-day ($442.3), both rising. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 10 and is now below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Nov 17 ($559.15), and RSI is 41.9.
read.zh: 微软 11月17日下跌 2.3%，收于 $506.24，盘中区间 $496.51–515.64。股价位于 5 日（$518.5）、10 日（$529.3）和 30 日均线（$529.5）下方，三者均在下行；位于 100 日（$483.1）和 200 日均线（$442.3）上方，两者均在上行。MACD 自 11月10日起位于信号线下方，现已跌至零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 于 11月17日转为看空（$559.15），RSI 为 41.9。

read.en: The drop broke the $513–513.8 support (SAR, Nov 13 low), now resistance, flipping the SAR. Resistance is $513.8–515.6, then $518–521.1 (5-day, Nov 16 and 11 closes) and $529.3–529.5 (10 and 30-day). Support is $505 (Nov 2 low), then $496.5 (Nov 17 low) and $483–486 (100-day, Sep 10 low). A close above $515.6 would target $518–521; below $496.5, $483–486.
